an6.96:1.1: XCVI. Channaṃ bhikkhave pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmim. Katamesaṃ channaṃ? Tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desetā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ, ariyāyatane paccājāti dullabhā lokasmiṃ, indriyānaṃ avekallatā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, ajaḷatā aneḷamūgatā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, kusaladhammacchando dullabho lokasmiṃ. Imesam kho bhikkhave channaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin ti.
